niche_preference_profile: Prefers calm, polished, editorial UI with light or softly neutral surfaces, generous whitespace, rounded low-contrast containers, restrained accents, friendly copy, and clear but not aggressive hierarchy. They generally like integrated layouts that feel cohesive, premium, and low-noise rather than flashy, mechanical, or heavily promotional.

criteria.description: Prefers a soft, calm, understated, editorial mood with restrained contrast and a polished premium feel rather than loud, harsh, corporate, or mechanical presentation.
Prefers open spacing, gentler pacing, and breathable layouts over compressed, tightly stacked, crowded screens.
Prefers fewer competing modules, less decorative chrome, and simpler screens without extra icons, galleries, badges, or fragmented callouts.
Prefers rounded, low-contrast cards or softly integrated surfaces that blend into the page rather than rigid, boxy, sharply separated panels.
Prefers conversational, supportive, plain-language phrasing over technical, procedural, compliance-oriented, or alert-like wording.
Prefers clear sectioning and readable hierarchy with strong organization but balanced emphasis, avoiding fragmented labels or overly loud headers.
Prefers a single flowing page or continuous list with cohesive progression rather than heavily chunked cards, nested modules, or split experiences.
Prefers muted, controlled accents and crisp but not flashy controls/buttons, avoiding overly bright gradients, neon emphasis, or attention-seeking CTAs.
